scope: Android Play page choice versus free-action presentation
player_behavior: When valid choices exist, the Play page shows only those choices and hides the free-action text field.
When no valid choices exist and the Run has not ended, the Play page shows 记录行动 and 提交行动.
An ended Run continues to show neither input mode and instead presents formal replay/return actions.
reason: Players should not be offered an input mode that the current ruleset cannot apply; this matches the desktop PlayScene boundary.
not_proven: Android physical-device touch, keyboard, and TalkBack behavior remain open because adb has no connected device.
